caption: Each node keeps only its best incoming edge, labelled with the score before the word's emission is multiplied in (0.12 into N, 0.18 into V). The orange run is the final backtrace: V's backpointer is N, so the best tag path is N V with δ₂(V)=0.108, while the two grey dashed edges lost and were never stored.

spec.aria: A Viterbi trellis for the words fish sleep: a start state and tags N and V at two positions, with four candidate scores on the middle-to-last edges, the best incoming edge kept at each last node, and the winning path start to N to V highlighted.
